CustomField.label: Units (Display)
CustomField.description: Coalesced unit count for tracker/reporting: uses the Opportunity's own Units__c, and for building-level pursuits (Business ROE / MDU linked directly to a Property Location) falls back to Property_Location.Property_Unit_Count__c when Units__c is blank. Property_Unit-linked Business Sales Opps have no direct Property_Location, so they keep Units__c only.
